# pangolin_ai_budgets (Data Source)

Lists the AI gateway budgets (spending caps) of the organization. At most one scope attribute is set per budget; none set means the whole organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_ai_budgets" "all" {}

# Budgets that are scoped to a provider.
output "provider_budgets" {
  value = [for b in data.pangolin_ai_budgets.all.budgets : b.id if b.provider_id != null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `budgets` (Attributes List) List of AI budgets, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets))

<a id="nestedatt--budgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The cap, in `unit`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is enabled.
- `enforcement` (String) What happens when the cap is reached.
- `id` (Number) The numeric budget ID.
- `model_id` (Number) Scope: AI model ID, or `null`.
- `period` (String) The reset period.
- `provider_id` (Number) Scope: AI provider ID, or `null`.
- `resource_id` (Number) Scope: public resource ID, or `null`.
- `role_id` (Number) Scope: role ID, or `null`.
- `site_resource_id` (Number) Scope: private (site) resource ID, or `null`.
- `unit` (String) The unit of `amount`.
- `virtual_api_key_id` (String) Scope: virtual API key ID, or `null`.
